candidate_source: new v40 branch from c78174e129296da3ac1efea71c0e61e36092af80; exact source and bundle hashes pending freeze

prior_evidence.scope: Both saved v29 diagnostics stopped during solo carry after three linked carrier frames because strong direct TOP cargo was unresolved. Those outcomes remain failures, not v40 results.

hypothesis: A previously cargo-correlated TOP carrier can be followed through a short visually supported cyan-silhouette loss if current orange corners relink to the old cloud, their motion agrees with the linked flow, and same-capture own RGB still validates attachment.

control_boundary.requires: --rolling-visual-servo and realtime dispatch_open without internal obstacles
control_boundary.first_three_proxy_frames: Original linked TOP RGB carrier route remains first; relink activates only after the original three-frame cap.
control_boundary.finite_budget: At most 12 total carrier-only observations including the original three, at most 3.2 SIM seconds from first proxy observation, and at most 105 pixels summed per-frame visual carrier motion; refreshed cloud does not reset any budget. The first proxy frame must be within 0.6 SIM seconds and after the last cargo-to-carrier visual-link frame.
control_boundary.direct_priority: Existing direct cyan and cargo-specific RGB KLT paths remain unchanged outside occlusion. During opt-in occlusion, even one strong cyan component is only provisional and cannot reset the finite proxy budget; recovery requires two consecutive strong current direct TOP cyan observations linked to current carrier motion, prior cargo appearance, and same-capture own attachment. At the final slot a provisional observation issues zero motion, then a new paired frame/time may confirm the stationary silhouette even if TOP JPEG bytes are identical.
control_boundary.final_delivery: Current strong directly segmented TOP cyan cargo must be inside the authored slot at each final waypoint observation and again on a fresh capture before the first release pose; carrier proxy alone cannot authorize final delivery or release. The original lowering/open/retract sequence is unchanged after that entry gate.
control_boundary.input: Student control uses current own RGB, common TOP RGB, self-issued command history, and authored static map only. Capture time is a freshness guard, not measured motion.
control_boundary.unchanged: Original cameras/FOV, rendering, physics/contact, grasp/release motion, weld OFF, owner leases and TTL, evaluation gates.

offline_acceptance: Both saved failure boundaries gain current carrier support from the old linked cloud with current own attachment and distinct TOP/own capture hashes; record exact per-frame support and budgets.
Nearby different orange object, partial/ambiguous cloud, detached/mismatched/panned own view, stale/repeated captures and exhausted total budget hold or fail closed.

One or two deceptive cyan components cannot switch identity or reset proxy budget unless the two-view appearance, carrier-motion, frame/time and current own-attachment gates all pass; provisional final-slot observation holds for a second view without placement or release.
If direct TOP cargo never returns, finite proxy use ends without final placement or release.
Existing v28/v29 direct/KLT/proxy success fixtures and default-OFF paths retain behavior.
physical_claim_boundary: Saved-frame replay and unit tests are component evidence only. Freeze source, bundle, models, map and run controls before any new native cohort; retain every launch and compare paired physical outcomes without inheriting v28/v29 success.
limitations: TOP RGB may show an edge-on or tilted cargo as thin weak cyan, not necessarily chassis occlusion. Carrier continuity is visual proxy evidence and cannot prove cargo pose/contact. No direct cargo return means intentional failure.
